title: Migrate Function Wrapping Choreography
summary: Migrated the generated function-wrap editor animation onto a shared compiled choreography plan and timeline: focus argument, reflow through 0.42, introduce parentheses only after reflow, delay f until 0.58, hold recognition, then release focus exactly. Runtime exposes plan/phase/checkpoint evidence, preserves one stage and opaque x continuant through handoff, integrates layout-safe CSS depth without changing x/y paths, and updates the dashboard exemplar comparison honestly.
